description: What is Temporal? Temporal is an AI-powered calendar that schedules your tasks around your **energy and focus patterns** — not just your availability. Most AI calendars find an open slot and fill it. Temporal finds the **right** slot: deep work lands in your peak focus window, meetings get batched in your natural social energy periods, admin fills the rest. Who it's for - **Product managers** drowning in meetings who need protected thinking time - **Developers** who need uninterrupted deep work
